intent: Identify the next diagnostic area for a measured TP2 KV-capacity startup rejection without claiming long-context quality, eight-image allocation, or a CPU-offload remedy.
observation: vLLM created both TP ranks and loaded 85.7 GiB per rank, then rejected C1 at 327680 because 4.16 GiB KV cache was required and 3.75 GiB was available.

evidence.text: At max seq len 327680, vLLM required 4.16 GiB KV cache but had 3.75 GiB available; its estimated maximum was 293216.
Both TP workers loaded the exact candidate; each reported 85.7 GiB model-loading memory.
The recorded stage is post-rank and post-weight-load but pre-KV-allocation: this is capacity evidence, not long-context quality or eight-image allocation evidence.
Startup resolved max model len 327680, while raw-config RoPE warnings remain insufficient to prove the worker effective YaRN object.
The r2 recipe kept PLE GPU-resident through engram cpu_offload=false; the observed KV shortfall does not support calling CPU offload a remedy.
Startup profiled one maximum-size image; configured eight-image request allocation remains untested.
